title: EDM_EVAL_MAX_BUDGET_USD is the only EDM_EVAL_* numeric knob with NO validation and it flows unchecked to claude -p --max-budget-usd at :492 -- the sibling timeout knob at :423-433 is validated with an exit-2 case precisely because the driver runs without set -e (CA-444), CI_JOB_TIMEOUT and KEEP_RUNS likewise, and the omission is DOCUMENTED as a known state at CLAUDE.md:1033 rather than fixed; a non-numeric/negative/multi-dot value in eval:nightly (the one job holding ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, acceptEdits, no human in the loop) either fails loudly or silently removes the per-phase spend ceiling from three phases, and nothing in the tree establishes which

run_with_timeout and cleanup both signal only $CURRENT_CHILD_PID, never the process group, so claude -p's own Bash-tool grandchildren (granted Bash(edm-state *)/Bash(edm-init *)/Bash(edm-validate-prefix *)/Bash(jq *) at :421) survive the 124-timeout and every INT/TERM/HUP with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY still in their inherited environment, outliving the containment boundary evals/README.md asserts -- and cleanup then rm -rf's $SCRATCH_DIR at :265-267 out from under them; the direct-child leak was analysed and closed at :465-470 but the grandchild case is addressed nowhere. Fix: set -m around the & and kill -TERM/-KILL -"$pid" with the single-PID kill as fallback

eval:nightly -- by its own comment at :794-797 the one job in the pipeline holding ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -- publishes the entire plugins/edm/evals/runs/ tree with when:always and expire_in:30 days, no exclude and no redaction, including raw/<phase>.stderr.log and raw/<phase>.json for every claude -p invocation (run-eval.sh:480); GitLab masks protected variables in job LOGS only, never in artifacts, so any future env-echoing diagnostic is published unmasked for a month. Re-raise of a round-8 item filed with id:null that never reached the ledger; no site writes the key to a file today, so this is an exposure surface rather than a demonstrated leak
